零成本创业（零成本创业（第22页）加列毕连忙说道。“哦？不好吧。”苍老的声音再度响起。“没什么不好的，能给您提供帮助，是我们的荣幸！请您千万不要有任何的客气，就当自己家一样！”加列毕，乌坦城三大家族之一的族长，此刻竟然完全是一副谄媚的嘴脸。这，便是四品炼药师身份带来的好处！于是，萧炎轻轻松松从加列家的药材库里，白嫖了一大堆自己需要的药材，完全就是和自己家一样，毫不客气，有多少拿多少。当天晚上，便是托药老将这筑基灵液炼制了出来，今天来到米特尔拍卖行，准备将其卖出。零成本创业，就是这么简单。当萧炎的思绪，转回来的时候，便是看到了谷尼那满脸崇敬的神色，和那鉴宝师热切的笑容。只见鉴宝师笑着开口：“大人，您是打算拍卖这灵液吗？”“嗯，一共五瓶，尽快卖掉。”萧炎淡漠点头，再度掏出四个玉瓶，放在了桌子上，药老的声音随之响起。“呵呵，这自然没问题，大人您持此令牌，去一号拍卖室，那里正好还在举行拍卖，您的灵液，待会就拍出！”鉴宝师笑着递过来一块漆黑的铁牌。“嗯。”随手接过铁牌，萧炎也不停留，直接在两人的注视中，行出了房间。“谷尼大师，他真的是一名炼药师吗？”瞧着萧炎消失之后，鉴宝师这才低声询问道。“嗯，的确是一名炼药师，那股敏锐而强大灵魂感知力，错不了…”谷尼点了点头，旋即眉头一皱，有些疑惑地自语道：“可他又是哪方势力的炼药师？没听说过乌坦城何时出了一个能够炼制二品丹药的炼药师啊？”“需要调查一下他的来历吗？”鉴宝师轻声道。谷尼老眼微眯，略微思量，微微摇了摇头：“暂时不要，炼药师的脾气都有些古怪，如果调查引起了他的注意，恐怕会让得他对拍卖场有不好的印象，随意得罪一位不知道等级的神秘炼药师，可不是什么明智的举动。”“是，那就按照乌坦城最尊贵的客户对待吧。”鉴宝师恭敬地行了一礼，并表示自己已经明白该怎么做了。另一边，在一名侍女的带领下，萧炎走进了正在举行中的拍卖会。一入其中，周围明亮的环境便是昏暗了下来，阵阵喧闹，铺天盖地的直灌入耳，吵得萧炎眉头微皱。拍卖场很大，容纳千百人并不是难事，此时，在拍卖场中央位置的灯光下，拍卖师清朗的声音响起，为场内的所有人解读着手中物品的功能。寻了一个偏僻的位置，萧炎安静的坐了下来，稍微听了片刻后，他便眼帘微垂，开始闭目养神。这个时间，雅妃还没有来到乌坦城的拍卖分行进行历练，有着药老的萧炎，也很难对一些寻常的黄阶斗技功法感兴趣。因此，这拍卖会对他来说，实在是没什么看头。

Zero Cost Entrepreneurship (Zero Cost Entrepreneurship (Page 22)) Jialebi said quickly. "Oh? Not good." The old voice sounded again. "There is nothing wrong. It is our honor to help you! Please don't be polite at all, just treat it as your own family!" Jialebi, the patriarch of one of the three major families in Wutan City, turned out to be completely flattering at this moment. This is the four The benefits of being a refining pharmacist! So, Xiao Yan easily bought a lot of the medicinal materials he needed from the Jialie family's medicinal materials warehouse, just like his own family, he took as much as he could. That night, the veteran Tuo Yao refined the foundation-building spirit liquid and went to the Miter Auction House today to sell it. Starting a business at zero cost is that simple. When he turned around, he saw Gu Ni's face full of reverence and the treasure appraiser's eager smile. The treasure appraiser smiled and said: "Sir, are you planning to auction this spiritual liquid?" "Yes, there are five bottles in total. Sell them as soon as possible." Xiao Yan nodded indifferently and took out four jade bottles again and placed them on the table. Yao Lao's voice sounded. "Haha, of course there is no problem. Sir, please take this order. Go to Auction Room No. 1. There happens to be an auction there. Your spiritual liquid will be auctioned later!" The treasure appraiser handed over a dark iron plate with a smile. "Yes." Xiao Yan took the iron plate without stopping and walked out of the room under the gaze of the two people. "Master Gu Ni, is he really an alchemist?" After watching Xiao Yan disappear, the treasure appraiser asked in a low voice. An alchemist's keen and powerful soul perception is unmistakable..." Gu Ni nodded, then frowned, and said to himself with some doubts: "But whose alchemist is he? Have you ever heard of an alchemist who can refine second-grade elixirs in Wutan City?" "Do you need to investigate his origins?" The treasure appraiser said softly. Gu Ni narrowed his eyes, thought a little, and shook his head slightly. He shook his head and said, "Don't do it for now. The alchemist's temper is a little weird. If the investigation attracts his attention, I'm afraid it will make him have a bad impression of the auction house. It is not a wise move to offend a mysterious alchemist who doesn't know the level at will." "Yes, then treat him as the most distinguished customer in Wutan City." The treasure appraiser bowed respectfully and said that he already understood what to do. On the other side, under the leadership of a maid, Xiao Yan walked into the ongoing auction. As soon as he entered, the bright environment dimmed, and the noise filled his ears, causing Xiao Yan to frown. The auction house was very large, and it was not difficult to accommodate thousands of people. At this time, under the lights in the center of the auction house, the auctioneer's clear voice sounded. Interpreting the functions of the items in his hands. Xiao Yan sat down quietly and listened for a while, then he closed his eyes and rested. At this time, Yafei had not yet come to the auction branch in Wutan City for training. It was difficult for Xiao Yan, who was a medicine man, to be interested in some ordinary Huangjie fighting skills. Therefore, this auction was really not interesting to him.
